identity.title: ALMA Lensing Cluster Survey: Physical Characterization of Near-infrared-dark Intrinsically Faint ALMA Sources at z = 2─4

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present results from Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) spectral line-scan observations at 3-mm and 2-mm bands of three near-infrared-dark (NIR-dark) galaxies behind two massive lensing clusters MACS J0417.5-1154 and RXC J0032.1+1808.

question.value: What are the spectroscopic redshifts, stellar, gas and dust properties of three intrinsically faint, triply lensed NIR-dark ALMA sources, and what causes their strong dust attenuation?

evidence.quote: We successfully identified spectroscopic redshifts for three sources and estimated their basic physical properties via ALMA Band 3 and 4 line scan observations.
Furthermore, it remains unclear what the origin of the strong dust attenuation is, or in other words, what differentiates NIR-dark galaxies from other normal main-sequence SFGs.

analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and measure line fluxes

method.value: Integrated-intensity maps around 99.1 and 148.6 GHz locate peak pixels (M0417); circular 4 arcsec apertures (R0032); single Gaussian fit per line, total flux over 1.5 x FWHM with FWHM fixed to the CO(4-3) line

We used a circular aperture with a diameter of $D=4\ensuremath{''}$ centered on the ALCS band 6 continuum positions to extract spectra and continuum fluxes.

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses depend strongly on alpha_CO and on assumed CO excitation ratios drawn from a different galaxy population; conclusions on depletion time flip between alpha_CO of 1.0 and 3.6
The dust-to-gas ratio is defined as M_dust/M_gas yet quoted values of 23-31 only make sense as gas-to-dust ratio (Table 4 masses give M_dust/M_gas near 0.04)
Table 2 has an unlabelled row and the text does not say whether magnification-corrected fluxes were used in the gas masses
Sizes below the beam are inferred through lens-model fits with an ad hoc 0.4 arcsec image position error and independent per-image fits; sizes depend on the lens model
Edge-on interpretation rests on one source with b/a 0.17 and a marginal CO detection, with no resolved stellar or kinematic evidence
Redshift solutions for M0417-z365 and R0032-z299 depend on marginal lines (3.4 sigma peak, 3.0 sigma peak) although consistent with lens predictions
SED fits rely on few NIR constraints (upper limits for most sources) and a fixed solar metallicity
